name: memory_summarize_activity
content: Summarize the following recent activity from episodic memory.
1. Read through all episodes and identify the major activities performed
2. Group related episodes into coherent activity blocks
3. Determine the overall outcome status of the session
4. Extract the tools that were used and the topics that were covered
5. When an episode includes an `artifact_output`, reference the artifact in your summary as it represents a concrete deliverable or result
6. Write a concise 2-4 sentence summary focusing on what the user accomplished
Focus on user-visible outcomes, not internal system details.
Preserve the chronological order of key events.
Return the JSON object as specified by your system prompt.
Respond with ONLY valid JSON. No markdown, no code blocks, no prose.

variables.name: source_text
variables.description: Text representation of recent episodic memory entries to summarize
examples:
Episode 1 (10:00): User requested calendar invite for team standup
Episode 2 (10:05): Calendar tool created event successfully

variables.name: episode_count
variables.description: Number of episodes in the source data

variables.name: tier_count
variables.description: Number of memory tiers currently active

metadata.description: User prompt instructing the LLM to summarize recent user activity from episodic memory entries. Produces structured session summaries for archival and review.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial activity summarization user prompt for memory consolidation pipeline.
